mapper.select: SELECT flt12_book_month_id AS book_month_id , flt12_account_id AS account_id , TO_DECRYPTS(flt03_account_no) || ' (' || sys15_corp_nm || ')' AS account_no , TO_CHAR(flt12_book_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS book_date , flt12_item_type AS item_type , flt05_item_type_nm AS item_type_name , flt12_item_nm AS item_name , flt12_item_cd AS item_code , flt11_book_qty AS book_qty , flt12_book_amt AS book_amt , COALESCE(flt05_stk_price_yn,'false') = 'true' AS stk_price_yn FROM flt12_book_month INNER JOIN flt03_account ON flt03_account_id = flt12_account_id INNER JOIN sys15_corp ON sys15_corp_id = flt03_corp_id INNER JOIN flt05_item_type ON ( flt05_company_id = flt12_company_id AND flt05_item_type_cd = flt12_item_type AND flt05_start_date = ( SELECT MAX(flt05_start_date) FROM flt05_item_type WHERE flt05_company_id = flt12_company_id AND flt05_item_type_cd = flt12_item_type AND flt05_start_date <= flt12_book_date ) ) INNER JOIN flt11_book ON ( flt11_company_id = flt12_company_id AND flt11_person_id = flt12_person_id AND flt11_account_id = flt12_account_id AND flt11_item_type = flt12_item_type AND ( ( COALESCE(flt05_stk_price_yn,'false') = 'true' AND flt11_item_cd = flt12_item_cd ) OR ( COALESCE(flt05_stk_price_yn,'false') != 'true' AND flt11_item_nm = flt12_item_nm ) ) AND flt11_book_date = flt12_book_date ) WHERE flt12_book_month_id = #{bookMonthId}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM flt11_book INNER JOIN flt03_account ON flt03_account_id = flt11_account_id INNER JOIN flt05_item_type ON ( flt05_company_id = flt11_company_id AND flt05_item_type_cd = flt11_item_type AND flt05_start_date = ( SELECT MAX(flt05_start_date) FROM flt05_item_type WHERE flt05_company_id = flt11_company_id AND flt05_item_type_cd = flt11_item_type AND flt05_start_date <= flt11_book_date ) ) LEFT OUTER JOIN flt12_book_month ON ( flt12_company_id = flt11_company_id AND flt12_person_id = flt11_person_id AND flt12_account_id = flt11_account_id AND flt12_item_type = flt11_item_type AND ( ( COALESCE(flt05_stk_price_yn,'false') = 'true' AND flt12_item_cd = flt11_item_cd ) OR ( COALESCE(flt05_stk_price_yn,'false') != 'true' AND flt12_item_nm = flt11_item_nm ) ) AND flt12_book_date = flt11_book_date ) WHERE flt11_company_id = #{companyId} AND flt11_person_id = #{personId} AND flt11_book_date = f_get_biz_date(flt11_company_id, f_get_last_day(flt11_book_date),'-0') AND flt11_book_date BETWEEN CAST(#{startDate} AS date) AND CAST(#{closeDate} AS date) AND flt11_item_type != '99' /*(99:예치금)제외*/ AND flt11_book_qty > 0 AND flt12_book_amt IS NULL
AND flt03_family_relate_cd = '1'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO flt12_book_month (flt12_book_month_id, flt12_company_id, flt12_person_id, flt12_account_id, flt12_item_nm, flt12_item_type, flt12_book_date, flt12_book_amt, flt12_item_cd) VALUES (#{bookMonthId}, #{companyId}, #{personId}, #{accountId}, #{itemName}, #{itemType}, CAST(#{bookDate} AS date), #{bookAmt}, #{itemCode})
